protocol: Independent extension of the first-use cohort, frozen before model inference on this source. Same scoring and first-three-cycle reservation as pulldown-r2-unseen-sources.json. Single reviewer marked lowest bar and next overhead return on 6 Hz RGB images with no pose predictions. Screened by source, continuity, angle and length only. Other screened items included Pexels 35585699 (possible same performer/session), 36871349 (too few complete cycles) and DVIDS 639891 (elastic band, split screen). No results from the preceding benchmark were consulted.

clips.author: khezez | خزاز
clips.terms: Pexels License https://www.pexels.com/license/. No source files in repository.
clips.notes: Continuous tall front-oblique portrait shot. Athlete initially grips the wide bar overhead; small overhead setup movements do not reach chest and are excluded. Lower to the chest, then extend to overhead on eight occasions. Real uninterrupted unlooped footage: torso, expression, bar and camera position evolve. A cable-machine upright enters from the left at the beginning of the set; far elbow or hand clipped by portrait framing at times. Creator also posted back-view 35585699, which was not included because the session/athlete may overlap.
